section: Iraq > Is it open, and how people go
old_str: in March 2024 Iraq's labour minister said tens of thousands had entered anyway, mostly undocumented, that few had used the ministry's 45-day regularisation window, and that foreign workers should come only as skilled workers, as carers for people with special needs, or matched one-to-one with an Iraqi worker on a project [OD0117, OD0118, OD0119].
new_str: in March 2024 Iraq's labour minister said tens of thousands had entered anyway, especially undocumented workers, that the number who registered under the ministry's 45-day regularisation window (later extended) did not match the number in the country, and that foreign workers should come only as skilled workers, as assistants for people with special needs, or matched one-to-one with an Iraqi worker on a project [OD0117, OD0118, OD0119].
problem: Overstates the source (Shafaq News, 31 Mar 2024): the minister said registrations 'do not match the actual number present', not that 'few' used the window, and said 'especially undocumented', not 'mostly'; the window was also extended.
